selection_rationale: Gunline doctrine: three battleships provide heavy spinal+coilgun firepower with thick nose armor (262cm) to win the coilgun duel at range and tank torpedo hits, while three cheap frigates add extra PD coverage, soak early torpedo salvos, and contribute coilgun fire. Full budget spent, no wasted points.
formation_rationale: Battleships form a shallow forward wedge: Sovereign-1 leads as the point to draw and absorb the first spinal/beam exchange, while Sovereign-2 and -3 flank wide and offset vertically to complicate enemy spinal targeting geometry and create crossfire angles, while still staying within ~100km for mutual PD support. The three Wards hold back as a reserve screen, spread laterally and vertically behind the battle line - close enough to extend overlapping point-defense coverage against incoming torpedoes/fighters, but far enough back to avoid being primary gun targets and to preserve them for flanking or finishing maneuvers.
